fix: extract $agent references when using default agent routing

When typing commands like "Incorporate feedback from $reviewer"
without an @agent prefix, the $reviewer reference was not being
extracted, preventing the referenced agent's output from being
injected into the prompt.

Root cause: When converting raw input to an AGENT command for
default agent routing, the Command object was created manually
without populating the references field.

Fix:
- Add extract_references() helper function to parser.py
- Call helper when creating Command in loop.py, app.py, router.py
- Add 13 tests (11 unit + 2 integration) for the fix

This ensures $agent context references work identically whether
using explicit @agent prefix or relying on default agent routing.
```
